chunks: Finding neither sleep nor any thing to drink
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the people of Hell will taste neither coolness nor drink?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Mursalat underscores the completeness of divine retribution, where the absence of 'cooling' (bard) and 'drink' (sharab) signifies not just physical torment but the total deprivation of mercy. Scholars note that these two elements represent the primary comforts of life, making their absence a profound symbol of eternal isolation from Allah's grace.
